profile.summary:
🚀 Passionate Software Developer | Full-Stack Engineer | AI Enthusiast | Cloud Architect

I'm a software architect and developer who specializes in transforming complex business challenges into elegant, high-performance software. With a unique background in architecting large-scale government enterprise systems, I bring a deep, foundational understanding of site reliability, data security, and systems integration to the fast-paced world of modern, cloud-native development.

My passion is in the complete application lifecycle, from architecting a full-scale migration of a monolithic application to a scalable, stateless architecture on the cloud, to engineering the resilient backend services and performant frontends that bring it to life. I thrive on solving complex problems and building products that are not only innovative but also secure, reliable, and built to last.

🌐 Portfolio: Check out my work at savanpatel.net.

📫 Let’s Connect: I’m open to discussing new opportunities, collaborations, or tech trends. Feel free to reach out!
